presentation: Three actual live-policy recordings side by side, scaled to 640x360 with a 40px title strip per column; existing world-aligned camera, grid and HUD preserved. No synthetic robot imagery.
early_termination_handling: If an episode ends before 10s, retain its last actual video frame with an explicit EPISODE ENDED label for the remaining comparison duration; original video remains unpadded.

visual_inspection.findings: All three actual robots fully visible at first/mid/last frames; readable original HUD, preserved world-aligned orientation and distance grid. Comparison retains complete robots in each panel and legible 40px policy title strips. Baseline turning and slower progress remain visible; no selected segments or omitted failures. All episodes last 10 seconds, so no freeze tails were used.
